## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: driver programs, violation surcharges, the point system and interstate compacts
Knowledge facts: part C holds 33 fact blocks (sec12-F01 onward) from physical pages 135 to 142; part C2 holds 19 confusable and continuation blocks (sec12-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 manual, the 50-question count and the 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical pages 32 and 33; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NJ-PTS-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NJ-PTS-D-NOTICE — scheduled suspension trigger and Driver Improvement eligibility wording (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- NJ-PTS-D-BLANK — chapter end page with no extracted text (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- NJ-PTS-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NJ-PTS-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: program fees, surcharge amounts and payment channels, and compact membership lists (for example sec12-F05, sec12-F13) can change and must be refreshed from the MVC website.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
